map.输入色浆浓度、黏合剂比例与配方总量，计算涂料印花色浆各组分(颜料、黏合剂、助剂): Enter the pigment paste concentration, binder ratio and total formula amount to compute the mass of each component (pigment, binder, auxiliary) of a pigment printing paste, for sample printing and production mixing.
map.涂料印花色浆配制：由涂料含量、黏合剂与交联剂比例一键算各组分质量，水与增稠剂补足: Pigment printing paste preparation: one-click calculation of each component mass from the pigment content and the binder and crosslinker ratios, with water and thickener making up the total.
map.印花打样配方调整：改涂料浓度或黏合剂比例即时重算，快速试小样。: Print proof recipe adjustment: change the pigment concentration or binder ratio to recalculate instantly and test small samples fast.
map.黏合剂用量优化：平衡手感与牢度，避免黏合剂过多发硬、过少脱落。: Optimizing binder dosage: balance hand feel and fastness, avoiding a hard hand from too much binder and shedding from too little.
map.棉布涂料印花色浆示例: Cotton Fabric Pigment Printing Paste Example
map.：配方总量 1000 g，涂料 10%、黏合剂 30%、交联剂 3%、增稠剂 4: Total formula 1,000 g with pigment 10%, binder 30%, crosslinker 3%, thickener 4% gives pigment 100 g, binder 300 g, crosslinker 30 g, thickener 40 g, with 530 g of water making up the total; the check confirms the sum is 100% and not exceeded.
map.涂料本身不与纤维结合，靠黏合剂成膜把颜料固着在织物表面，其用量与种类决定牢度与手: The pigment does not bond to the fibre itself; the binder forms a film that fixes the pigment on the fabric surface, and its dosage and type determine fastness and hand.
map.加交联剂可提升膜的交联密度改善耐洗与耐磨；但过量可能使手感变硬，按黏合剂类型与牢: Adding a crosslinker raises film crosslink density and improves wash and abrasion resistance; but too much may make the hand feel stiff, so balance it against the binder type and fastness requirement.
map.比例超 100% 会怎样？: What Happens If the Ratio Exceeds 100%?
map.表示配方各组分加和超过总量，水无法补足，实际无法配制；工具会提示超限，需下调某组: It means the sum of the formula components exceeds the total, water cannot make up the difference and it cannot actually be prepared; the tool flags the overflow and you need to lower the proportion of some component.
